title: 搜索引擎
problem_statement_md:
你正在编写一个搜索引擎。

给定的代码将一个**文本**和一个**单词**作为输入，并将它们传递给一个叫做`search()`的函数。

如果文本中存在该词，`search()`函数则返回 "Word found"，否则返回 "Word not found"。
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Search Engine[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

You’re working on a search engine. Watch your back Google!

The given code takes a [b]text [/b]and a [b]word [/b]as input and passes them to a function called [b]search()[/b].

The [b]search()[/b] function should return "Word found" if the word is present in the text, or "Word not found", if it’s not.

[b]Sample Input[/b]
"This is awesome"
"awesome"

[b]Sample Output[/b]
Word found

[note]Define the [b]search()[/b] function, so that the given code works as expected.[/note]
hint_md: 定义`search()`函数，使给定的代码按预期工作。

code_templates.template:
text = input()
word = input()

print(search(text, word))

testcases.stdin:
this is some sample text
some
